root_cause: Safety context is not propagated to every surface that serves an exercise
finding_ids: F015,F020,F023,N02,N04, train-tab chips, equipment detail page
evidence_summary: One eligibility layer exists and is correct. Six surfaces call the injury-only catalogue instead, or call nothing.

root_cause: Model output is rendered without validation against the catalogue
evidence_summary: parseDescription validates shape, never membership. No eligibility call anywhere on that path.

root_cause: The refusal exists but does not reach the user
evidence_summary: Every mechanism is built. The user sees a network error, a routine referral for chest pain, a false safety promise at collection, and never sees the coverage figure.

root_cause: The default programme path never adopted the spec pipeline
evidence_summary: Four templates have a ProgrammeSpec and are screened, structured and validated. Three do not and fall to a scheduler that walks an id-sorted pool.
fix_scope: add one spec, delete the fallback

root_cause: Data is collected and never consumed
evidence_summary: At least 14 questionnaire fields and 12 health fields reach no engine. Sensitive ones sit unencrypted in SharedPreferences.

root_cause: Server state is writable by the client
evidence_summary: The users/{uid} wildcard excludes only subscription, so quota, receipts and the health block are all client-writable.

root_cause: Catalogue columns are degenerate, and one product claim outruns them
evidence_summary: difficulty is 1877/1887 beginner; recognition covers 10 of 69 machines against "scan any gym machine".

root_cause: Two safety questions are unresolved rather than unimplemented
evidence_summary: The untagged-row severity is contested 1-1 between independent readers and needs a clinician. Pregnancy needs a product decision on wording, not on mechanism.
